Subject: Duplicate Partner Center referral - Contoso (need owner)

Hi Sean —

We noticed two active Partner Center referrals for Contoso in the Azure PC dashboard that are pointing to different Redwood sellers. This is causing conflicting co-sell outreach from Microsoft field sellers and blocking a joint opportunity rollout.

Attached is the CSV export from Partner Center showing both referral records (referral IDs, created_at, seller_id). Can you help confirm which Redwood seller should be the canonical owner? Contoso prefers a single seller contact for technical and commercial conversations.

Short ask: can someone from Redwood validate the correct owner and propose a quick remediation plan (update/refund/re-assign referrals) so the MS field can stop duplicate outreach?

Thanks,
Sarah Lim
Sr. Partner Ops | Contoso Cloud

Thanks for flagging this, Sarah — looping in Vanessa and Karthik to own the reconciliation.

Vanessa / Karthik: can you triage the attached PC export and propose the canonical owner by EOD tomorrow? Key constraints: Contoso prefers a single seller IDM for all co-sell activities; Microsoft will honor the referral tied to the seller_id that's in Partner Center unless we reassign via Partner Center support.

Proposed immediate steps (suggested):
- Quick sync to confirm Contoso’s preferred contact (15m)
- Internal owner reconciliation (map by account id, domain, and latest engagement)
- Submit referral reassign request to Microsoft if needed (we'll include Contoso PO/approval)

I attached a short playbook I usually use for these - it includes a rollback step if we accidentally disable the active referral.

Best,

Sean — thanks, will take point. I dug into the CSV and did a quick owner-recon (attached owner-recon-v1.csv). High-level:
- Referral A (seller_id=redwood-01) is tied to a PoC engagement started Apr 2026 and has the majority of technical touchpoints.
- Referral B (seller_id=redwood-07) was created May 2026 via a marketplace listing click and has no logged technical meetings.

Recommendation: designate seller_id=redwood-01 as canonical owner and request MS to reassign Referral B to redwood-01, then collapse duplicate referral entries. Steps I’ll run after you approve:
1) Confirm Contoso’s preferred named contact (Sarah, is this fine?)
2) Prepare Partner Center reassign request and include Contoso approval email
3) Ask MS ops to pause outreach for referral B while reassign is in process (can they throttle?)

I also propose a short canary approach: reassign one referral for a small set of accounts and validate with field sales that outreach stops. If green, continue with the rest.

—Vanessa

Adding a few technical notes from the Platform side:
- Partner Center referral metadata has two relevant keys: referral.seller_id and referral.source. The marketplace click created a referral record but often the PoC owner (our AE/BDR) will be set via manual seller claim. We need to reconcile both keys.
- I can run a small script to join Partner Center exports with our CRM (HubSpot) to validate which seller has active opportunities for Contoso. That will give us a defensible canonical owner.

Karthik: I’ll schedule a short 20m runbook call to go over the join and to agree scope for the canary. Proposed time: 1 Jul 2026 15:00 PT. Link: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/partner-ops/contoso-mapping
